newsitem.title: SPAIN: Spain's La Seda to increase share capital.
newsitem.headline: Spain's La Seda to increase share capital.

text.p: Spanish textile group La Seda de Barcelona said on Monday it will increase its share capital by 1.96 billion pesetas to 8.51 billion pesetas.
A statement said that Westdeutsche Landesbank Girozentrale and Catalana de Iniciatives will subscribe around 40 percent of it with a total investment of 760 million pesetas.
Westdeutsche Landesbank will take 29 percent of the capital increase for 560 million pesetas, while Catalana de Iniciatives will buy 10 percent for 200 million pesetas.
Shares in La Seda resumed trading in April 1996, after having being halted for some years.
